17 Market St Unit 9, New Albany, OH 43054
3 bd / 2.5 ba, 1,600 sq ft. HOA dues: $180 per month. Property tax approx 1.8% of price annually. Seller concession: 3% of price toward buyer's costs. Buyer pays a one-time $500 move-in deposit to the HOA. Insurance estimated at $900/year. Mortgage insurance not required on this loan.
